en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a detailed Gothic stone tympanum with multiple registers of sculpted biblical figures. The scene appears to depict the Last Judgment: Christ in the center, angels, saints and crowds of the resurrected, surrounded by archivolt figures. The view is cropped tightly to the sculpture above a cathedral doorway. Vertical caption text runs along the right edge of the card.
